pages.title: Components
pages.summary: Fomantic's vocabulary as ui-* custom elements, by topic.

pages.title: Accordion
pages.summary: An accordion allows users to toggle the display of sections of content.

pages.title: Actions
pages.summary: Actions hold what a user can do next:  a comment's reply links, a modal's or toast's buttons.

pages.title: Advertisement
pages.summary: An ad displays third-party promotional content.

pages.title: Author
pages.summary: An author names who wrote a comment or did a feed event.

pages.title: Avatar
pages.summary: An avatar is a small picture of a person, beside a comment, an item or a card.

pages.title: Breadcrumb
pages.summary: A breadcrumb is used to show hierarchy between content.

pages.title: Button
pages.summary: A button indicates a possible user action.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.summary: A calendar lets a user pick a date, a time, or both.

pages.title: Card
pages.summary: A card displays site content in a manner similar to a playing card.

pages.title: Checkbox
pages.summary: A checkbox allows a user to select a value from a small set of options, often binary.

pages.title: Code
pages.summary: Code shows a block of source code coloured by its language, from the element's own text or a file on this site.

pages.title: Comment
pages.summary: A comment displays user feedback to site content.

pages.title: Container
pages.summary: A container limits content to a maximum width.

pages.title: Content
pages.summary: Content is the main block of a card, item, feed event, comment, modal, message, list item or step.

pages.title: Date
pages.summary: A date says when something happened, inline and small inside a feed event.

pages.title: Description
pages.summary: A description is the text of a card, item, modal, list item, step or comment.

pages.title: Detail
pages.summary: A detail is a label's dimmer second value, such as a count.

pages.title: Dimmer
pages.summary: A dimmer hides distractions to focus attention on particular content.

pages.title: Divider
pages.summary: A divider visually segments content into groups.

pages.title: Dropdown
pages.summary: A dropdown allows a user to select a value from a series of options.

pages.title: Embed
pages.summary: An embed displays content from other websites, like YouTube videos, loaded only when asked for.

pages.title: Emoji
pages.summary: An emoji is a glyph used to represent something else.

pages.title: Extra
pages.summary: Extra content is set apart from the main content, such as a card's footer.

pages.title: Feed
pages.summary: A feed presents user activity chronologically.

pages.title: Flag
pages.summary: A flag is used to represent a political state.

pages.title: Flyout
pages.summary: A flyout is a modal that slides in from a side of the page.

pages.title: Form
pages.summary: A form displays a set of related user input fields in a structured way.

pages.title: Grid
pages.summary: A grid is used to harmonize negative space in a layout.

pages.title: Content parts
pages.summary: Headers, content, descriptions, metas and the other generic parts that cards, items, modals and messages share.

pages.title: Icon
pages.summary: An icon is a glyph used to represent something else.

pages.title: Image
pages.summary: An image is a graphic representation of something.

pages.title: Include
pages.summary: An include shows part of another page from this site in this one, loaded at once, when idle or when scrolled into view.

pages.title: Input
pages.summary: An input is a field used to elicit a response from a user.

pages.title: Item
pages.summary: One item for dropdowns, lists and menus, rendered by whatever holds it.

pages.title: Items
pages.summary: A group of items presents a set of site content for display, each an image beside its text.

pages.title: Label
pages.summary: A label displays content classification.

pages.title: List
pages.summary: A list is used to group related content.

pages.title: Loader
pages.summary: A loader alerts a user to wait for an activity to complete.

pages.title: Markdown
pages.summary: Markdown renders GitHub-flavoured markdown -- tables, task lists, code blocks -- from the element's own text or a file on this site.

pages.title: Menu
pages.summary: A menu displays grouped navigation actions.

pages.title: Message
pages.summary: A message displays information that explains nearby content.

pages.title: Meta
pages.summary: A meta holds metadata about the content, such as a date or a category.

pages.title: Modal
pages.summary: A modal displays content that temporarily blocks interactions with the main view of a site.

pages.title: Nag
pages.summary: A nag is a persistent message that stays until dismissed, and can remember the dismissal.

pages.title: Panel
pages.summary: A panel is an inspector:  a tinted box of fields under a header band, with sub-head bands that fold.

sections.title: Loading a band from a file

pages.title: Placeholder
pages.summary: A placeholder is used to reserve space for content that soon will appear in a layout.

pages.title: Popup
pages.summary: A popup displays additional information on top of a page.

pages.title: Progress
pages.summary: A progress bar shows the progression of a task.

pages.title: Radio
pages.summary: A radio button lets a user choose exactly one value of a group.

pages.title: Rail
pages.summary: A rail is used to show accompanying content outside the boundaries of the main view of a site.

pages.title: Rating
pages.summary: A rating indicates user interest in content.

pages.title: Reveal
pages.summary: A reveal displays additional content in place of previous content when activated.

pages.title: Root
pages.summary: A root loads the components inside it on demand, sets their theme, size, icons and emoji, and shows them once they're ready.

pages.title: Search
pages.summary: A search module allows a user to query for results from a selection of data.

pages.title: Section
pages.summary: A section is a titled block of content that can fold away and keep its title in view.

pages.title: Segment
pages.summary: A segment is used to create a grouping of related content.

pages.title: Select
pages.summary: A select lets a user choose a value from a list, with the platform's own picker.

pages.title: Shape
pages.summary: A shape is a three dimensional object displayed on a two dimensional plane.

pages.title: Sidebar
pages.summary: A sidebar hides additional content beside a page.

sections.title: Triggering custom behavior with other content

pages.title: Slider
pages.summary: A slider allows users to select values within a range.

pages.title: Statistic
pages.summary: A statistic emphasizes the current value of an attribute.

pages.title: Step
pages.summary: A step shows the completion status of an activity in a series of activities.

pages.title: Sticky
pages.summary: Sticky content stays fixed to the viewport while its container is on screen.

pages.title: Summary
pages.summary: A summary is a feed event's main line:  who did what, and when.

pages.title: Tab
pages.summary: A tab is a hidden section of content activated by a menu.

pages.title: Table
pages.summary: A table displays a collection of data grouped into rows.

pages.title: Text
pages.summary: A text is used to style some inline text with a simple color.

pages.title: Textarea
pages.summary: A textarea is a multi-line field used to elicit a longer response.

pages.title: Title
pages.summary: A title heads a step, an accordion panel or a search result.

pages.title: Toast
pages.summary: A toast allows users to receive a short, non-blocking notification.

pages.title: Transition
pages.summary: A transition is an animation used to show or hide content, or to draw attention to it.

pages.title: Value
pages.summary: A value is what a statistic shows:  a number, a word, an icon or an image.

pages.title: Visibility
pages.summary: Visibility provides a set of callbacks for when content appears in the viewport.
